name: rule-guard
description: Enforces your rules on Bash commands in code, not by asking nicely: blocks AI attribution in commits and PRs, asks before destructive commands, and blocks patterns you choose, optionally only under certain folders.

blockAiAttribution.title: Block AI attribution in commits and PRs
blockAiAttribution.description: On: a git commit, tag or gh pr command that carries "Co-Authored-By: Claude" or "Generated with Claude Code" is refused, and Claude removes the line and retries.

confirmDestructive.title: Ask before destructive commands
confirmDestructive.description: On: you are asked first before rm -rf on a broad target, git push --force, git reset --hard, git clean -f, DROP TABLE/DATABASE and chmod -R 777.

customDenyPattern.title: Block commands matching (regex)
customDenyPattern.description: Your own rule: a Bash command that matches this pattern is refused. Example: 9VP73Q9QX3 to keep an Apple team ID out of commands. Leave empty to skip.

customDenyScope.title: Only when the folder contains
customDenyScope.description: Limits your own rule to some folders. Words separated by commas, such as /company/ or a project name; the rule applies only when the session's folder path contains one. Empty means everywhere.

customDenyMessage.title: Message when your rule blocks
customDenyMessage.description: What Claude is told when your own rule refuses a command. Say what to do instead.
customDenyMessage.default: This command matches a pattern you blocked.

requireKoreanCommit.title: Commit subject must be in Korean
requireKoreanCommit.description: On: a git commit whose subject has no Hangul is refused. Only messages typed on the command line (-m or a heredoc) are read.

bannedCommitTags.title: Tags that only name a kind of work
bannedCommitTags.description: Words separated by commas. A commit or PR title that starts with one of them in brackets, such as [기능], is refused, so the bracket names the feature that changed ([로그인]) and not the kind of work. Applies to commit messages typed on the command line and to gh pr create or edit titles. Leave empty to skip.

commitSubjectPattern.title: Commit subject style (regex)
commitSubjectPattern.description: A pattern the commit subject must match. Example: ^\[[^\]]*[가-힣][^\]]*\]\s requires a Korean tag in brackets such as [기능] at the start. Leave empty to skip.

defaultSubagentModel.title: Default model for subagents
defaultSubagentModel.description: sonnet, haiku, opus or fable. A subagent started without a model gets this one instead of the session's (often the priciest). Leave empty to skip.

subagentKeepModelFor.title: Subagents that keep their own model
subagentKeepModelFor.description: Words separated by commas. A subagent type that contains one is left alone. Example: architect,planner.
